Build the app described below in an existing Next.js 16 project (App Router, React 19, strict TypeScript).

Stack: Once UI Stack is set up: this project was generated by the Stack scaffolder with its dashboard surface (a product shell with sidebar, header, organisation switcher, user menu and demo data, running in demo mode with no backend), and it uses `@once-ui-system/core`. Read `project/AGENTS.md` first: it maps where everything lives. The Once UI agent documentation installed with it is in the `docs/` folder (start with `docs/AGENTS.md`).

Task: Haven, a home search site for Lisbon. At `/`, a search page: a filter bar (type, price range, minimum bedrooms, and a sort by newest, price or size), a results count, and the results as cards (photo placeholder drawn with CSS, price, title, beds, baths, area, district, a badge for homes listed in the last 7 days, and a save toggle) beside an interactive map. The map uses `maplibre-gl` (installed, as is `react-map-gl`) with the free map style URL in the data, centred on the given point: this style URL and its tiles are the only network resources the app may load. Every home shows on the map as a price marker; hovering a card highlights its marker and hovering a marker highlights its card; clicking a marker opens a small popup card. Filters update the list, the count and the markers together. On phones, the list and the map are two views with a toggle. At `/homes/h-104` (and every home's own `/homes/[id]`), a detail page: a gallery strip of CSS placeholders, price and key facts, the features, an energy rating, a small map with the home's location, and a contact form for the agent (name, email, message, all required, with inline errors) beside the facts on desktop.

Use this data for the content (define it in the code; you may put it in `src/lib/data.ts`):

Requirements:
- The app must serve these routes: `/`, `/homes/h-104`. Each route default-exports its page from its `page.tsx`; nested layouts are allowed.
- Write as many files as the app needs, under `src/app/`, `src/components/`, `src/lib/`, `src/content/` or `src/resources/`. You may change any file that already exists in the project: send the whole new file. Files you don't send stay as they are. You can read the project's existing files under `project/`.
- Put "use client" at the top of every file that uses state, effects or event handlers.
- Use realistic placeholder content defined in the files (no lorem ipsum). Load nothing from the network: no external image, font or API URLs.
- The app must type-check under strict TypeScript, pass `next build`, and render every route without console errors.
- Make it responsive from phone to desktop, and accessible.

# Lumen: notes for coding agents

Read this before the tree: it says where everything lives, so you can go straight to the files a task needs.
Built with Next.js App Router and `@once-ui-system/core`; composition in `stack.json`.

## Map

### Shell
- **Brand, theme, fonts:** `src/resources/once-ui.config.js` — `baseURL`, `fonts`, `style` (brand, accent, neutral, border, theme mode), `dataStyle`, `schema` (product name, logo, email), `social`.
- **Language:** `i18n.locales` in `src/resources/once-ui.config.js` (first = default; sets `<html lang>` and how prices are formatted). Server: `getLocale()` from `src/lib/i18n/server.ts`; client: `useLocale()` from `src/components/LocaleProvider.tsx`. A surface's UI text lives in `src/content/<surface>/labels.ts` (one entry per locale), read with `labelsFor()` from `src/lib/i18n`; translate there, not in components.
- **SEO:** `src/resources/seo.js` exports one object per surface (title, description, path, image); pages pass them to `Meta.generate` and `<Schema>`.
- **Root layout and providers:** `src/app/layout.tsx`, `src/components/Providers.tsx`. MDX rendering: `src/components/Mdx.tsx`. Icons: `src/resources/icons.ts`.
- **Content barrel:** `src/content/index.ts` re-exports the copy files under `src/content/`.

### Dashboard & product shell
- **Signed-in shell:** `src/app/(product)/layout.tsx` with `components/Sidebar.tsx` and `components/Header.tsx` (org switcher, user menu). Org pages: `src/app/(product)/app/[org]/` (home, analytics, users, settings). `/app` redirects to the first org, `/app/demo` in demo mode.
- Routes: `/app`, `/app/[org]`, `/app/[org]/analytics`, `/app/[org]/settings`, `/app/[org]/users`, `/profile`

### Supabase auth
- **Auth:** pages in `src/app/(auth)/auth/` (sign in, sign up, forgot password) and `/auth/update-password`. Supabase clients in `src/lib/sb/`; rate limiting and route gating in `src/lib/sb/proxy.ts` and `src/lib/sb/middleware.ts`, run from `src/proxy.ts`. `isSupabaseConfigured()` in `src/lib/sb/config.ts` switches demo mode (no env vars: nothing gated, sample data). Schema: `supabase/init.sql`.
- Routes: `/auth`, `/auth/update-password`

### Organizations & multi-tenancy
- **Organizations:** guards in `src/lib/orgs/server.ts`; every org-scoped query goes through them (RLS is on with no policies). Roles and `DEMO_ORG_SLUG` in `src/lib/orgs/types.ts`; invitations in `src/lib/orgs/invitations.ts` and `src/app/(orgs)/invite/[token]`; API in `src/app/api/orgs/` and `src/app/api/invitations/`. Schema: `supabase/orgs.sql`, run after `init.sql`.
- Routes: `/invite/[token]`

## Rebranding

These files still carry the template's identity (name, URLs, trademarks, demo copy). Replace or delete what the app does not need; keep the auth, org and billing code as it is unless the task says otherwise.

- `src/resources/seo.js` (30)
- `src/app/(product)/app/[org]/components/TableClient.tsx` (5)
- `src/components/Mdx.tsx` (2)
- `src/app/(auth)/auth/components/AuthCard.tsx` (2)
- `src/resources/once-ui.config.js` (1)
- `src/app/(product)/app/[org]/users/components/TableClient.tsx` (1)
- `src/app/(product)/components/Header.tsx` (1)
- `src/components/effects/PrismGlow.tsx` (1)
- `README.md` (1)

Search: `stack\.once-ui\.com|magic-convert|once-ui-system\/stack|Once UI|Lorant|\/trademarks\/|once-ui\.com\/pricing`. Logos and demo images live in `public/`.

## Checking your work

`npm run typecheck`, then `npm run build` (needs no environment variables: the app runs in demo mode), then `npm start` and request the pages.

# @once-ui-system/core — agent harness

This package ships an agent-first codegen harness under `ai/`, next to this file. Use it when **writing Once UI code**, not full MDX documentation pages. Paths below are relative to this file (in an app: `node_modules/@once-ui-system/core/`).

## Starting an app

A new signed-in app (sidebar, top bar, content panel) starts from `ai/starters/app/`: a working Next.js App Router setup with Once UI's CSS, fonts, providers and theme in `src/app/layout.tsx`, the shell mounted once in `src/app/(app)/layout.tsx`, and two pages. Copy it over the create-next-app files, then edit it rather than rewriting it:

```bash
cp -r node_modules/@once-ui-system/core/ai/starters/app/src/. src/ && rm -f src/app/page.module.css src/app/globals.css
```

No `src/` folder? Copy into the project root instead.

The copy takes `src/` only: also set `experimental.optimizePackageImports: ["@once-ui-system/core"]` in `next.config`, as `ai/starters/app/next.config.ts` does, or every route that imports the package root from a server component ships about 110 kB of extra JavaScript.

- `src/resources/app.ts`: product name, user and nav. The sidebar, breadcrumb and ⌘K palette all read it. Each nav href needs a page under `src/app/(app)/`; copy `home/page.tsx`.
- `src/resources/once-ui.config.ts`: brand, accent, neutral and `defaultTheme` (`theme` itself stays `"system"`, or the theme switch stops working).
- `src/components/AppShell.tsx`: the frame. Change it only to change the frame; it already covers the app-shell bundle's quality bar.

Then build each page from the bundle below that fits it.

## Writing a page or feature

Every file you read is sent again on every later turn, so read what you need in one step, then write.

1. Pick the bundle below closest to what you are building and read it, together with any project files you need (in a Next.js app at least `app/layout.tsx`, which mounts the providers), in a single step. Open those project files by path: listing their folder first costs a turn, and every turn re-sends the bundle. A bundle is complete: the rules, every component's props, types, gotchas, the quality bar and a gold example. Then write the code.
2. Need a component the bundle does not list? Every bundle has the components in the `page.md` row; the Adds column names what each one carries on top. Read the `ai/components/<Name>.json` of anything else your page needs in that same step, not after the bundle.
3. Nothing fits? Read `ai/bundles/page.md` (the rules and the common components) with the `ai/components/<Name>.json` slices your page needs, in one step. `ai/catalog.json` names every component with its purpose.

Never open `ai/spec.json`: it is the full machine spec, for tooling.

<!-- tasks:start -->
| Bundle | For | Adds |
|---|---|---|
| `ai/bundles/marketing-hero.md` | Marketing hero: Headline with text effect, CTA pair, social proof logos, background effect | Background, RevealFx, LetterFx, LogoCloud, Line |
| `ai/bundles/pricing.md` | Pricing page: Three tiers, highlighted middle tier, feature comparison table, FAQ accordion | Background, MatrixFx, BlobFx, RevealFx, CountFx, SegmentedControl, Table, AccordionGroup |
| `ai/bundles/settings.md` | Settings page: Vertical section tabs, profile form, settings rows with one control each, grouped sub-settings, danger zone | Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel, Form, Select, Setting, SettingGroup, SettingAxes, InfoTip, Switch, Slider, NumberInput, Checkbox, MediaUpload, Table, NavItem |
| `ai/bundles/dashboard.md` | Analytics dashboard: KPI stat cards, charts area, recent-activity list | Background, CountFx, StatusIndicator, Table, SegmentedControl, LineChart, BarChart, ChartHeader, RevealFx, Line, Drawer, NavItem |
| `ai/bundles/chat.md` | Chat UI: Message list with avatars, typing indicator, composer with send and attach, conversation list | ChatMessageList, ChatMessage, ChatComposer, TypingIndicator, ConversationItem, SplitView, EmojiPickerDropdown, Fade, Kbd, User, Line |
| `ai/bundles/auth.md` | Auth flow: Sign-up / login with social auth, email form, stacked dialog for OTP | PasswordInput, OTPInput, Media, SmartLink, Line |
| `ai/bundles/roadmap.md` | Product roadmap: Kanban-style roadmap with status columns and task cards | Card, StatusIndicator, User, Scroller |
| `ai/bundles/list-page.md` | List / table page: A page of records: title with the primary action, a status filter, a searchable, sortable, paginated Table with status tags and row actions, and an empty state | SegmentedControl, Select, Table, DropdownWrapper, Option, Map, MapMarkers, MapPin, MapPopup |
| `ai/bundles/editor.md` | Editor shell: A toolbar, a resizable two-pane split (layers and canvas) and a timeline spanning both — video editor, page builder, diff view | SplitView, Scrubber, ToggleButton, Media, MediaVideoPlayer |
| `ai/bundles/docs-page.md` | Docs or blog article: An MDX article: breadcrumb trail, title and summary, Markdown rendered through the /mdx component map, and an on-page heading nav | Breadcrumbs, HeadingNav, MdxHeading, Feedback, CodeBlock |
| `ai/bundles/app-shell.md` | App shell: Signed-in app frame shared by several routes: sidebar with nested nav groups and the current route highlighted, header with breadcrumb, account or workspace menu and command palette, phone drawer | Nav, NavGroup, NavItem, Drawer, Breadcrumbs, UserMenu, DropdownWrapper, Option, Kbar, Kbd, KeyTip, Line, Table |
| `ai/bundles/page.md` | Any other page: The rules and the components nearly every page uses, with their types and gotchas. Read it with the `components/<Name>.json` slices your page adds, in one step | Column, Row, Grid, Heading, Text, Button, IconButton, Icon, Input, Textarea, Tag, Badge, Avatar, Dialog, Skeleton, VisuallyHidden; this bundle alone also has Switch, SegmentedControl, Select, Checkbox, Card |
<!-- tasks:end -->

Validate generated code: `npx once-ui-validate-ai-code path/to/file.tsx`. Without a bundle, app shells, sidebars and editors are in `ai/layouts.md`, and Pro blocks to compose from are listed in `ai/examples/blocks/manifest.json`.

## Setup

`npx once-ui-init-agent` points a consumer app's AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules here. Without `node_modules`, use https://docs.once-ui.com/ai/manifest.json (may not match your installed version exactly).

Read it with the `components/.json` slices your page adds, in one step This file is complete for this task: the rules (all of `rules.compact.md`), the props of every component below, their mixins and types, every gotcha for these components, the quality bar and a gold example. Write the page from it; reading the rules, catalog, gotchas, manifest or examples again only adds cost. Open `components/.json` only for a component not listed here, and then every one you need in a single step. ## Rules ### Layout | Write | Never write | |-------|-------------| | `` | `` | | `` | ``, or `` with no direction | | `fill` | `fillWidth fillHeight` | | `fit` | `fitWidth fitHeight` | | `center` | `horizontal="center" vertical="center"` | | `maxWidth="l"` | `fillWidth maxWidth="l"` | | `fillWidth` | `fillWidth minWidth={0}` | | `width="32" height="32"` (32 px, a spacing token); `height={20}` (320 px: past `"160"` there is no token, use rem) | `width={32} height={32}` (a number is rem: 512 px), `height="320"` (not a token) | | `border` | `border="neutral-alpha-weak"` | | `` | a `` and a `` | - `Flex` only when direction changes at breakpoints: `` - Subtree theme: `theme`, `themeBorder`, `themeSolid`, `themeSurface` on Flex/Row/Column/Grid and components built on them (`Background`, `Tag`, effects) — not raw `data-theme`/`data-border`/`data-solid`. `Button`/`IconButton` have no typed prop: keep `data-border="rounded"` - App theme in `once-ui.config` `style`: `defaultTheme: "light"` = starts light, visitor can switch (`theme: "light"` forces it and `setTheme` does nothing). Exact brand colours: `brandScale`/`neutralScale` `{ 100: "#…", …, 1200: "#…" }` (with or without a seed; per theme `{ light: {…}, dark: {…} }`), page/card colour: `pageBackground`/`surfaceBackground` (token or colour, or `{ light, dark }`), not overrides of semantic CSS variables - Page skeleton: `Column as="main" fillWidth horizontal="center"` → content `Column maxWidth="l"` → sections - Section gaps: `"104"` between sections, `"24"`–`"40"` inside. Never `"48"` between major sections. - Responsive: breakpoint props `xl l m s xs` — never media queries for layout ### Surfaces Static panel recipe (pricing tiers, stats, settings sections): ```tsx ``` - Bare `border` (and `borderTop`, `borderBottom`, …) = the default border. Name a colour only to deviate: `border="brand-alpha-medium"`. - `Card` = interactive only (`href` or `onClick`). Static panels = Column + surface recipe. - Colors: `{scheme}-{weight}` or `{scheme}-alpha-{weight}`. Never hex/rgb — inline SVG `fill`/`stroke` included: `currentColor` or `var(--brand-solid-strong)`. - `background` also: `surface | overlay | page | transparent` ### Typography - Hero: `display-strong-l` or `display-strong-xl` - Section titles: `display-strong-xs` or `display-strong-s` — not `heading-*` - Eyebrow: `` - Text on layout: `textVariant` + `onBackground` on Row/Column instead of nesting Text ### Decoration Absolute layers always: `position="absolute" top="0" left="0" fill pointerEvents="none"`, content `zIndex={1}`. - `zIndex` only inside that layer group (or on a sticky header over its pane).
